title: Independence of normalized coordinate signs
statement: For every $n\ge 0$, let $X$ be uniformly distributed on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. The $n$ random variables $X_i/\sqrt n$, indexed by $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, are mutually independent.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying measure is uniform on the sign cube
